output.summary: A biennial herb native to Eurasia and North Africa. It forms shiny dark-green basal rosettes and dense clusters of bright yellow spring flowers, usually with a peppery taste. Young leaves are eaten raw or cooked, buds and flowers are edible, and flower shoots are eaten after cooking.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves are eaten raw or cooked; buds and flowers are edible, while flower shoots require cooking.
